blind_spot: checks that fail open with no record (rows 3, 5, 11, 20)

rows.sees: A question shows on your page
rows.why: 159 changes in 7 days; 14 were fixes. 12 open debts: the judge misses a past ruling. How often you use the page is not measured.
rows.gold: Each question shows at the next build. No open debt. Page use is measured.

rows.why: 38 changes; 3 were fixes. One answer needed a second press. A peer's brief was saved as your words.
rows.gold: One press sends it. Only your own words are saved as yours.

rows.why: The copy was 11 hours old on Nov 11. The writer check misses the stored shape. No test goes red on it. An unknown writer passes with no word.
rows.gold: The copy is under 1 hour old. A test goes red on a missed shape. An unknown writer is refused and logged.

rows.sees: A pull request or batch merges
rows.why: 186 changes; 25 were fixes. About 20 open debts. A job that timed out counted as not red.
rows.gold: A timed-out job counts as red. Few open debts, and none that blocks a merge.

rows.sees: CI goes green or red, and a wake tells the session
rows.why: No push run on main has finished since Nov 9, 11:56 CST; 11 were cancelled. Windows shards hit the 20-minute cap and never run on a pull request. The CI wake never fires in the cloud.
rows.gold: Each push to main ends green or red inside 20 minutes. Every shard runs on a pull request. The wake fires on every machine.

rows.why: 2 of 3 lanes started from main, not from the branch their brief named.
rows.gold: Every lane starts from the branch its brief names.

rows.why: 4 open debts. The handoff guards fire often.
rows.gold: A resumed session loses no ruling. A handoff guard fires only on a real miss.

rows.why: 287 changes; 38 were fixes. About 48 of 120 debts name a guard file. Only 3 guards have a canary test that proves they go red.
rows.gold: Each guard has a canary that goes red on its defect. Few debts name a guard.

rows.why: 62 false-alarm notes; 22 say “Fix: none”. Whether the Nov 10 cull ran is unknown. The log lives on one machine.
rows.gold: Each false alarm gets a fix or a ruling. The cull runs, and says so. One log for every machine.

rows.why: 4 round trips so far. One message showed as sent and was never stored. 5 messages ever, 1 of them real. The wake is not built. Off by default, by your ruling. 35 tests, none for a lost message, the off switch or a second account.
rows.gold: No message is lost. Tests cover a lost message, the off switch and a second account.

rows.why: 110 changes; 15 were fixes. The reply judge reads every fifth stop and never refuses.
rows.gold: Each report is read. A miss is refused once, with the reason.

rows.why: No spend record in git. The share of work on Haiku is not measured.
rows.gold: Spend per session and per model is in git, and read each week.
rows.no_part: no spend record exists yet, so no part measures it

rows.sees: The model cap refuses a spawn
rows.why: 9 changes; 2 were fixes. 3 open debts.
rows.gold: No spawn runs above its role's model without your grant. No open debt.

rows.why: How many review rounds really run is not measured.
rows.gold: Rounds and verdicts are counted per change. No change passes 3 rounds.

rows.sees: The roadmap and the Status tab
rows.why: 1,520 steps. The upkeep list looks for the status “active”, which no step has. 352 of 391 steps in progress were not touched in over 24 hours.
rows.gold: The upkeep list finds every live step. No step in progress sits untouched for a day.

rows.why: The Windows sweep went red twice on main. 515 branches on origin.
rows.gold: The sweep is green on every platform. Only open lanes keep a branch.

rows.sees: Docs and the map stay true
rows.why: The map covers 6 of about 194 code files (3%).
rows.gold: The map covers every code file. A stale cite fails CI.

rows.why: 38 of 121 rules are enforced (31%). 58 have no guard or check (48%).
rows.gold: Each rule that a mistake can break has a guard or a check.

rows.why: Cloud installs: 24 of 24 OK. Your own machines: not measured. A long cloud session keeps the copy it started with.
rows.gold: Each machine runs main from its next session start, and each is measured.

rows.sees: A judge flags a decision or prose edit
rows.why: The prose judge lets an edit through when the model call fails. How often is not measured.
rows.gold: A judge error is logged and counted on this tab.
